messages:
maria: heads up — after promoting v2p1 (int4) to 10% we’re seeing a regression on the "folded" slice (long instructions + code blocks). A/B vs v2p0: MRR -6.2%, factuality/hallucination F1 +4.3pp. signal popped ~15m after rollout.

chris: can you paste the short diffs? which metric is our autofallback watching (exact expr)?

maria: short diffs:
- MRR_overall: v2p0=0.721 -> v2p1=0.677 (-6.2%)
- MRR_folded_slice: 0.690 -> 0.618 (-10.4%)
- hallucination_F1 (manual eval sample): 0.42 -> 0.463 (+4.3pp)
- p50 latency: +3ms (irrelevant)

chris: our auto-fallback rule currently is: delta(MRR, 1h) <= -0.02 AND delta(halluc_F1, 1h) >= +0.03 measured on promoted slices. If both true -> immediate fallback.

devin: saw something similar in a shadow run last week. suspicious KV-cache prefix mismatch for long prompts (cache hits drop -> token distribution shift). Recommend quick diagnostic: run 1k folded-slice queries in shadow with kv_cache disabled and compare logits overlap.

devin: command to run on perf harness:
```
/opt/eval/harness/run_eval --model v2p1-int4 --slice folded --samples 1000 --kv-cache off --dump logits_diff.json
```

anya: do we have a variant fallback ready (nf4 or v2p0-quant-safe)? We should avoid full rollback if a compatible variant exists. Current routing table has v2p0-nf4 and v2p0-int8 pinned as fallback.

sam: immediate suggestion: scale v2p1 -> 2% traffic, enable routing fallback to v2p0-nf4 for requests matching folded slice. Start a focused shadow run for 30m. If autofallback rule triggers, allow it to auto-cutover (but set cooldown to 10m so we don't oscillate).

deploy-bot: Deploy event recorded: v2p1-int4 promoted to 10% at 6423456700 by release-bot. No rollback action taken yet.

maria: action plan:
1) roll traffic down to 2% now (sam).
2) start shadow-run with kv_cache off + logits diff (devin).
3) create focused eval bucket for folded slice (2000 samples) and run concordance + hallucination check (maria/anya).
4) if delta(MRR) <= -4% OR halluc_F1 +3pp sustained for 30m -> allow autofallback to v2p0-nf4.
5) post-mortem and tweak gating to include prefix-cache hit rate as a gate signal.

chris: please also add seqlen distribution delta to the dashboard (compare promoted vs baseline). that was missed last rollout.

maria: noted. assigning owners: traffic rollback = sam, shadow diag = devin, focused eval + infra dashboard = anya/chris. will update the rollout ticket and ping on completion.

sam: on it, scaling down now.

devin: starting harness job — will upload logits_diff.json to the thread when done.

anya: I’ll wire up the folded-slice eval bucket and start the concordance run; ETA 45m.

maria: thanks all. if autofallback triggers, don’t escalate automatically; we’ll review before permanent promote/rollback changes. :thumbsup:

sam: ack.

deploy-bot: Rollback-suggestion hook armed: cooldown=10m, threshold_rule_id=autofb-23.

maria: last note — add a small canary check to detect KV-hit ratio drop > 8% as a new automatic gating signal. low effort, high signal.

chris: agreed. opening infra ticket to surface KV-hit ratio metric to per-variant monitor.

maria: thread owner: maria. will follow up with the ticket links once created.
